top_signals.title: Australia’s Second-Largest Pension Makes Big Bullish Bet on Yen
top_signals.summary: Australia’s second-largest pension has built its biggest overweight position in the Japanese yen in years, betting that markets are underpricing Bank of Japan interest rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India Takes Growth Pitch Abroad as Foreign Money Pulls Back
top_signals.summary: India is taking its growth story to global investors, seeking fresh capital as foreign money flees the country’s markets and student protests expose some of the challenges facing its young population.
